name: Chopin Chocolate
about: A Warsaw chocolate brand, and its packs often feature piano and Chopin designs that link the sweets to the city's most famous composer.
tip: Pick the piano-design pack if you want something that clearly says Warsaw.

name: Bolesławiec Pottery
about: Hand-painted stoneware from Bolesławiec in southwestern Poland, a regional craft that is also sold in Warsaw shops.
tip: Buy one small cup first to check the glaze and painting before choosing larger pieces.
